$comment-hidden-rule: chore, ci, docs and test are hidden from the changelog: they change how the repo is worked on, not what it ships. They are listed so the section names stay stable if one is ever unhidden.
$comment-what-cuts-a-release: build, deps, feat, fix, perf, refactor and security change what ships and appear in the changelog. feat bumps minor; a `!` in the title or a BREAKING CHANGE footer bumps major; everything else patch. Nothing is uploaded anywhere: a release is a tag plus GitHub release notes, and the version in safe-app-manifest.json is rewritten to match.
